mode: deterministic index-only reduction of existing licensed full-body source
near_asset: exact original stage6 geometry, maps, skeleton and animation
far_asset: Per-primitive u16 indices; shared immutable attributes. Never merge materials.
protected: all triangles with blended weights or different joint IDs
acceptance: same-context live-shadow ABBA draw and GPU profile
runtime tests and public-path review before publication
limitations: sampled surface distance is not a global Hausdorff proof
fixed-scene GPU cost is not live game FPS acceptance
